name: text-repel
title: Text Repel
description: Splits text into words or characters that repel from the pointer. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-blocks/text-repel-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-text-repel text="Hover over me" mode="words" />
</template>

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and animate.

props.name: mode
props.description: Whether to split by words or characters.

props.name: strength
props.description: Maximum distance in pixels to repel text elements.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius around the cursor where repel effect is active.

props.name: falloff-power
props.description: Power curve for falloff (higher = sharper falloff).

props.name: hover-target
props.description: CSS selector for an external hover target. Defaults to this element.
